caption: The drawing depicts a wooden container shaped like a triangular barrel with slightly curved sides. The body of the container is made of vertical brown wooden staves, held together by five wide, horizontal metallic bands colored in a dull yellowish-brown. Near the top edge, there are two small round holes on the sides, where a dark metal handle is attached. The handle arches upward and has a thick, cylindrical wooden grip, also brown, with grooves, attached to its center. The lid of the container fits into the opening and appears to be composed of wooden planks aligned with the staves, bordered by the same metallic banding. The entire composition is centered on a light, beige background, and there is a small signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Triangle Field Water Keg
